content.comment_body: Hello all, I'm seeking a way to restrict timer values when configuring with [product_name] [version_no], using [article_no]. The project is simple, involving some buttons and valves operating in cycles triggered by button presses. The requirement is to let users set ON and OFF times for the valves. To reduce entry mistakes, I aim to enforce a minimum and maximum for the timer (between 5s and 50s), so that any value input outside these bounds is automatically corrected to the allowable limit. Appreciate any recommendations. EDIT: The adjustments will be made through the integrated [product_name] display, not via external panels.
I've attached an example for reference.
Thank you for the quick reply. Your help was greatly appreciated!
